title: ΔrH from enthalpies of formation
caption: For C₂H₄ + H₂ → C₂H₆, both routes from the elements must give the same total: ΔrH = ΣΔfH(products) − ΣΔfH(reactants) = −84 − (+52) = −136 kJ mol⁻¹.
alt: A Hess triangle: reactants C₂H₄ + H₂ top left, product C₂H₆ top right, elements 2C + 3H₂ at the bottom; arrows from the elements up to each side.
description: Up to C₂H₄ + H₂: ΔfH = +52 kJ mol⁻¹ (H₂ is an element, 0).
Up to C₂H₆: ΔfH = −84 kJ mol⁻¹.
